entries.positive_observation: The final derivative preserves the approved parent RGB exactly. The yellow compact round mascot has two dark-brown eyebrows, green-ringed solid black eyes, one neutral closed mouth, a clean upper lip and chin, no human skin, nose or ears, and no added sideburns, glasses, moustache or beard. The near-frontal slight image-right pose, upward/right gaze, bright frontal modeling, under-visor shadow and original bust crop remain recognizable. The blue-gray peaked cap retains one upper gold eagle, one lower winged gold wreath around a circular cockade, black visor, gold braid and oakleaf detailing. The dark-blue uniform retains two gold shoulder boards, two large gold-embroidered collar patches, a white pointed shirt collar, dark tie and one prominent black-and-silver throat cross. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without pinching, floating cloth or a cream bib. The pale ivory-gray/greige painted backplate fills the complete rectangle; no frame, note, halo or replacement backdrop was added. Full final white/cyan/alpha viewing shows solid clothing and backing without interior holes, exterior cutouts or matte rings.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the derived RGBA for production. The exact source and final output both have measured alpha extrema [255,255], and source/resized/output corner arrays are all [255,255,255,255]. Independent read-only comparison confirms final RGB bytes equal the approved parent and final alpha bytes equal the source alpha resized to 1776x2368 with BILINEAR; resized_alpha_sha256 is 11e122a90e29c4446b6c237e34e49cbf168d719980366098d97c5453f58620c1. The full sheet confirms a legitimately opaque rectangular portrait; cyan panel-edge strips are letterboxing, not output transparency. This is a derived alpha-repaired output, not a native transparent return.
entries.visible_limitations: At 156x210 the precise cap insignia interiors, gold collar embroidery and neck-cross suspension details cannot be transcribed reliably. Their visible counts and placements were checked without inventing microscopic detail, and these evidence limits are not rejection grounds.
